verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes Claude Code's general coding, git, MCP, and automation capabilities but never mentions accepting a sketch, image, or PDF as design input to scaffold or generate an app. The closest reference (claude-code-docs-23) only describes updating an email template from Figma designs shared in Slack, not app generation from visual designs. Missing for 10: any documentation or example of image/PDF/sketch-to-code app generation, multimodal input support in the CLI, or a demonstrated workflow turning a design mockup into a working application. [2026-09-30 judge-migration owner-product bias audit: reverted opus-5-5 partial q3 -> the committed sonnet-5 baseline none q0. Every cited item is about Figma/Drive design-doc access or plain-language coding; none is ABOUT sketch/image/PDF-to-app generation, and the Opus rationale concedes 'none of this shows direct design-to-app generation'. Under the v3 evidence-relevance rule off-story material must not move the verdict (the pilot memo's flip-read 1 documents this exact workaround-generosity failure mode). Anthropic-affiliation governance, README §9.]
